name.en-US: The Four Great Evils of the Day
name.pt-BR: Os Quatro Grandes Males do Nosso Tempo

description.en-US: The Four Great Evils of the Day (1871): four Lenten lectures at the Pro-Cathedral, Kensington: the revolt of the intellect against God, the revolt of the will against God, the revolt of society from God, and the spirit of Antichrist.
description.pt-BR: Os Quatro Grandes Males do Nosso Tempo (1871): quatro conferências quaresmais na Pró-Catedral de Kensington: a revolta da inteligência contra Deus, a revolta da vontade contra Deus, a revolta da sociedade contra Deus e o espírito do Anticristo.

en-US.editor: Henry Edward Manning (London: Burns, Oates and Co., 1871)

sources.edition: The Four Great Evils of the Day (London: Burns, Oates and Co., 1871), Internet Archive full-text OCR.
sources.description: The four lectures; the contents and the publisher's list of books are dropped. Running heads and page numbers are dropped; the OCR was cleaned of line-break hyphens and the commonest recognition slips, and isolated slips remain. Raw OCR in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Cardinal Henry Edward Manning died in 1892 and the edition is of 1871, so the text is public domain.

title.en-US: Lecture I. The Revolt of the Intellect against God
Lecture II. The Revolt of the Will against God
Lecture III. The Revolt of Society from God
